payload.reason: The evidence clearly outlines the main motivation of the paper, which is to provide a method for annotating error types in grammatical error correction systems, thereby facilitating better evaluation and feedback.

claims.text: The main aim of this paper is to rectify the lack of error type analysis in GEC systems by providing a method for automatic annotation of error types.
The paper introduces ERRANT, a toolkit designed to automatically annotate parallel error correction data with explicit edit spans and error type information.
The motivation includes standardizing existing error correction corpora to reduce annotator workload and improve evaluation accuracy.
